title: Our Story
subtitle: Real wood, slow smoke and food made with passion.
story: Flame and Grill Smokehouse started with a simple idea: serve proper Australian barbecue from a food truck, without cutting corners. Every cut of meat is seasoned by hand and smoked low and slow over real wood.
From tender brisket and fall-off-the-bone pork ribs to stacked burgers and loaded fries, our menu is built around bold flavour and fresh ingredients.
Find us on the road, or order online for pickup from the truck or delivery to your door in selected postcodes.
